title: Game HUD: centred header with day pill, no phase bar, Tomorrow first, quieter stall row
problem: The game screen's header and phase bar take height and text; the owner wants a calmer HUD.
scope: Header as a 3-column grid: menu and a D{day} pill with day ticks on the left, the event badge dead centre, rank and cash on the right
The phase bar (Morning, Buying, Stocking, Bell, Rush) removed
The Tomorrow strip above today's customers
The stall row's two header labels removed
exclusions: No change to the wholesale market, your shelf, the action bar or game mechanics
No rule, balance or save change

acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on the merge: 1302 passed, 1 skipped (as before)

PORT=8887 E2E_MINUTES=15 npm run test:e2e on 5dbcbe8 (same code as the merge): E2E OK, leaks 0 (pricing 88 frames, reactions, quick match 50 frames); the performance budget passed on its built-in second try (first 285 ms on a shared machine)

acceptance.text: Screens at 390x844, 360x640 and 412x915 in every phase; header centring measured
acceptance.evidence: 69 screens in the session scratchpad p127 at 390x844, 360x640 and 412x915: every phase, 5 and 6 stalls, League stages, Sprint, last day; page scroll 0 on all; event centred within 0.01 px on all (centring.json); side-by-side with the mockup

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-24: "Refactor the main game HUD and screen layout ... (1) minimal and truly centered top header bar: day pill D{n} with a progress bar of day ticks, event badge dead centre, rank and cash compact; (2) remove the phase navigation bar; (3) Tomorrow strip first, today's customers second; (4) remove the STALLS IN BUYING ORDER and What each bought today labels. Do not alter the wholesale market, your shelf, the action bar or the mechanics."

added: A D{day} pill with one tick per day
changed: The header is a centred 3-column bar with the event in the middle
Tomorrow's strip sits above today's customers
fixed: The event badge was up to 23 px off centre
removed: The stall row's labels and the header's days-left text

playerNotes: A calmer game screen: the day as a small pill, the event in the middle, tomorrow's customers first, and no phase bar
